description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ReportData' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report'. It specifies the methods 'normalize' and 'getMeta', intended to be implemented by classes that represent report data within the OrangeHRM system. The interface promotes a standard way to handle report data and metadata in the application.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the report data object normalized to an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves optional metadata associated with the report data as a ParameterBag instance.
